_about: Where every piece of art still to be made lands, how big it must be and what in the game shows it, for the art waiting on PixelLab's credits (docs/24, A51 on, D344; and the earlier rows whose place the game already reads, D358). `tools/take_art.py` reads it: `check` says, for each request, what is in DROP-ZONE/<id>/, what is already in place and what is still the stand-in; `take <id>` checks each file's size and moves it to `to`. A file is matched by its name (`name`, without the folder); a PixelLab zip is unpacked first. `size` is [width, height] in pixels; `rotations` is a folder of the eight facings (south.png, south-east.png, ... as art/items/bone_sword); `each` repeats a file for every name in it, `{each}` in `name` and `to`. `prop: false` marks a picture under art/props that is not laid as a prop (the opening draws it). `stand_in` says what shows until the art is in, `shows` where it is seen and what reads it, so nothing but generating is left on the day. `also` names earlier requests a file answers too (A58's pictures are A10 to A25's keepsakes).
